name: the sword in the branches
place: old tree behind the artisans guildhall
clue: hark knight, thou art unarmed! a blade awaits in the shade of the old tree behind the artisans' guildhall.
task: find a fallen branch and rub it on rough stone til its sharp. it is thy sword now, so do not let go of it. not once.
item_desc: a trusty blade, sharpened by thine own hand.

name: the squirrels plea
clue: a squirrel of a brave clan blocketh thy path and looketh at thee like supper. he needeth thy aid!
task: gather five nuts around the guildhall and lay them out in the shape of a flower. back away slowly if he is still staring.
item_desc: a gift from the squirrel clan. worth more than gold to them.

name: the ghost riders bench
clue: stone steeds stand frozen mid gallop, and the ghost of a rider drifteth near. 'sit and think, traveler,' he whispereth.
task: sit on the bench and pick the steed that would carry thee to the prince. give it a legendary name and say it aloud for the ghost.
item_desc: it jingleth softly though no horse is near.

name: the trolls bridge
clue: a troll sleepeth beneath the bridge. one wrong step and he wakes!
task: cross the bridge softly. shadows are lava, so only step in the sunlit gaps. touch a shadow and thou must start over.
item_desc: a chipped tooth the troll left behind. he did not seem to mind.

name: the bards challenge
clue: a bard by the creek sneereth, 'a knight? i have seen braver mice. match my rhythm if thou darest!'
task: beatbox a rhythm of thine own by the creek til the bard is shamed (or thou runnest out of breath).
item_desc: a silver string, proof thou hast bested the bard.
